question: Dissolution of the State Legislative Assembly before the expiry of its term can be brought about by

options.text: two-third majority vote of the members of legislative assembly

solution:
The correct answer is __**the Governor .**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• According to** Article 174 of the Indian Constitution**, the following circumstances could result in the state Assembly's dissolution:

 
 
• When the** state Legislature** is unable to elect a **Chief Minister **and form a government.
 
• When a** coalition disintegrates.**
 
• If the **assembly elections **are delayed for whatever reason.
 
• If it is necessary to stop a state split.
 
 
 
• In each of these cases, it is the** state governor's duty** to assess the circumstance and make a** recommendation regarding** whether or not the** State Assembly **should be dissolved.
 
• When the governor is certain that the **state cannot run** according to the terms of the Constitution, the **President** must make **this pronouncement.**
